items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: No, I didn't know any of the bands there because, you know, soon after that I left and then it went on and on.

ctx.x: They, they had, uh, dances downstairs, and then they used to have them in that yard. Oh, I see. Uh-huh. They have a paved yard there. And they used to have dances in that yard. Uh-huh. Do you know any of the bands that were there?
At the Bulls very much other than Owey?
No, I didn't know any of the bands there because, you know, soon after that I left and then it went on and on.
